description: Insulation contractor in Hayward, CA for flatland tracts, the hills above Cal State East Bay and the west side, 6 miles from our base. Get a free inspection.
intro: East Bay Insulation works across Hayward from our San Leandro base, about 6 miles north via I-880. We cover the flatland tracts, the hillside streets above Cal State East Bay and the industrial west side of town.

paragraphs: Flatland tract homes sit close to the bay and usually stand over crawl spaces that pull damp air into the house. Up the hills above Cal State East Bay, homes sit on steeper streets with cooler evening air, and the west side mixes housing with industrial blocks.
Those three settings call for different insulation plans, so we start with a free inspection and quote from what the house actually shows us.

bullets: Crawl space encapsulation and vapor barriers
Attic insulation replacement and air sealing

faqs.q: How far is Hayward from your base?
faqs.a: About 6 miles south of San Leandro via I-880, which puts most Hayward inspections within the same week.

faqs.q: Do you serve the hills above Cal State East Bay?
faqs.a: Yes, along with the flatlands and the west side. Every part of Hayward gets the same free inspection and written estimate.

faqs.q: What do Hayward crawl spaces usually need?
faqs.a: Many flatland homes have crawl spaces that need a vapor barrier or full encapsulation to stop damp air from rising. The inspection confirms what your house needs.
